lines.en: Here we are, the shrine of Galzus!  Your upgrade awaits, Diana.
lines.zh: 我们到盖泽斯的神殿了！ 你就要变厉害了，戴安娜。
lines.name: 贝雅特丽

lines.en: Still sealed away.  Seems the Empire hasn't figured out how to open these doors on their own yet, else they would have already.
lines.zh: 门还是封住的。 看来帝国还没有想出打开这些门的方法，不然他们早就打开了。

lines.en: Something is calling out to me...  It is difficult to resist...
lines.zh: 有什么在呼唤我…… 这种感觉很难抵挡……
lines.name: 戴安娜
